subject: Coordinating exec demo times across US / EU / APAC — availability window negotiation
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 09:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the quick turnaround during the intro call. Our execs want a focused 30–40 minute walkthrough next week that includes our CTO (Paris), Head of Product (Hamburg) and two commercial leads in the US.

Constraints: EU execs prefer 15:00–17:30 CET; US execs prefer 08:00–11:30 PDT; APAC (Japan) would need 19:00–21:00 JST. I realize that's a very narrow overlap — can we find a short window or split into two sessions?

I can propose candidate slots but wanted to check if you have a preferred ordering (single consolidated demo vs split technical + exec).

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Martin
Commercial Director, Acme Energy

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

Sophie — great summary. Heads-up: US switches to DST on Sun Mar 13 (clocks forward 1 hour) which compresses morning availability for our West Coast execs. That might knock out some of the earliest proposed windows.

Quick thoughts:
- We prefer a single consolidated session if we can get 30 min of executive presence + optional 20 min technical deep-dive that other engineers can join asynchronously.
- Candidate overlapping window around UTC 15:30–16:30 looks promising for a single session if EU can push to 16:00 CET (that becomes 08:00 PDT during DST) and APAC can do 00:00+ JST (not ideal).
- If that’s rough, propose a split: one exec-friendly slot for high-level (30m), and a separate technical follow-up with APAC engineers during their office hours.

I can run a quick availability sweep internally and share a compact matrix. Marcus, Lauren — can you flag exec availability (LA morning / SF morning) for Mon/Tue/Wed next week?

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Energy Execs <execs@acme-energy.eu>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 11:30:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

Thanks, Jonas.

Our execs confirmed they can flex a bit later on Monday or Tuesday (targeting 16:00–17:00 CET). They are not available after 17:30 CET due to other commitments.

If US morning gets squeezed by DST, I think the simplest path is: 16:00 CET Monday (which is 07:00 PDT after DST) for the consolidated exec slot (30 minutes). Kenji (APAC) says he can join remotely at 00:00 JST if needed but prefers a follow-up technical session earlier in his day.

I attached the latest mutual action plan and SSO notes. Let me know if the 07:00 PDT option is workable for your US execs.

Sophie
(attachments: mutual_action_plan_ACME.xlsx, acme_sso_requirements.pdf)

From: Kenji Sato <ksato@tokyo-ai.jp>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 02:07:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

Apologies for chime-in — I’m on the Acme thread as an engineering partner. 00:00 JST is workable for me (I can stay online for 30–40m) but it’s not preferred for the rest of the Tokyo team. If the execs want to keep everyone present, a split session is much better: high-level at a PST-friendly morning; technical deep-dive at 10:00–12:00 JST (which maps to late afternoon CET).

If we must do one-time overlap, we should keep the consolidated session to 30 minutes max and send pre-recorded demo clips for the APAC team.

— Kenji
Senior Engineer, Tokyo AI Integrations

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

On Mar 12, 2027 Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu> wrote:
> Our execs confirmed they can flex a bit later on Monday or Tuesday (targeting 16:00–17:00 CET).

Thanks — quick internal note: our VP (SF) can do 07:00 PDT on Mon/Tue but prefers 08:00 PDT. Because US jumps to DST on Mar 13, 07:00 PDT on Mon becomes 08:00 PDT local after DST — confusing when invites cross clients’ calendars.

Proposal (compromise):
- Exec consolidated slot: Mon 2027-03-15 16:00 CET / 07:00 PDT (hosted as "Europe/Paris" timezone on the invite so CET times show correctly for EU execs). Keep to 30 minutes and agenda: 10m intros, 15m value demo, 5m Q&A.
- Technical follow-up: Tue 2027-03-16 10:30 JST (APAC-friendly) / 02:30 CET / 18:30 PDT previous day for US engineers who can join late. Marcus will lead the technical session.

I attached a simple timezone_overlap_matrix.csv with conversions; attaching calendar invite stubs as well. Jonas — can you confirm with your exec and I’ll send calendar invites with explicit timezone tags?

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
(attachments: timezone_overlap_matrix.csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@acme-energy.eu>, Kenji Sato <ksato@tokyo-ai.jp>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 14:22:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo — executive availability (US / EU / APAC)

Thanks everyone — this is helpful and practical. Confirming:

1) Exec consolidated session: Monday, 2027-03-15 at 16:00 CET / 07:00 PDT (Mon local for US after DST) — 30 minutes. I will mark the event timezone as Europe/Paris when creating the invite so EU shows local time correctly; invite will include both UTC and local offsets.

2) Technical deep-dive: Tuesday, 2027-03-16 at 10:30 JST — Marcus to present (45–60m). We’ll record and leave a short pre-recorded clip in the folder for any APAC folks who can’t make the live overlap.

Action items:
- I will send the calendar invites (separate events) with explicit timezone tags and a short agenda.
- Sophie: thanks for the MAP and SSO notes; Marcus will follow up on the SSO ask prior to the tech session.
- Lauren: please include the exec names in the invite attendee list and mark them as required.

I’ve attached the mutual action plan and will share the HubSpot deal link in the calendar notes. Looking forward to it.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachments: mutual_action_plan_ACME.xlsx, acme_sso_requirements.pdf)
